newsitem.title: TURKEY: Istanbul stocks seen higher with selective trade.
newsitem.headline: Istanbul stocks seen higher with selective trade.

text.p: 0648 gmt -- Turkish stocks are expected to open higher on optimism, raised by formation of Prime Minister Mesut Yilmaz's new government, brokers say.
* The IMKB National-100 closed at a record high of 1,857 on Monday, 42 points, or 2.31 percent higher from Friday's close.
* Analysts expect support at around 1,820-1,830 and resistance at around 1,950 level.
